empty_state_description: Add pages to your site — About, Team, and more. Each page appears as a tab in the menu.
empty_editor: Select a page to start editing
home_pin_tooltip: Pinned here for editing — set its position in the published menu in the nav bar above
slug_invalid: A page URL needs at least one letter or number.
slug_taken: The page {{title}} already uses this URL. Choose a different URL.
slug_reserved: The site already uses /{{address}}/ for something else. Choose a different URL.
slug_address: Your page's address on the site: /{{address}}/
slug_warning: When you next publish, this page's address changes from /{{old}}/ to /{{new}}/. Links to the old address will stop working.
slug_same_address: This changes how the page's file is named, not its address on the site. The page stays at /{{address}}/ and its links keep working.
nav_bar_intro: In addition to stories and objects, Telar lets you create standalone pages for your site — an About page, a Team page, methodology notes, or anything else you'd like to share with your readers.
nav_bar_instructions: Pages appear in your site's top menu bar. Use the preview below to manage them: drag items to rearrange the menu order, click a page to edit its content, or use the + New Page button to add one.
repo_pages_description: Import them into the editor to manage their content here.
scan_not_made: We couldn't check GitHub for pages you could import. We'll keep trying, or you can try again now.
